subject: Renewal QBR + Roadmap demo — regional breakouts & presenter rotation

Subject: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — regional breakouts?

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for partnering with us on the upcoming renewal QBR. We want to use the session as both a contract checkpoint and a short roadmap demo for our product and engineering stakeholders. A couple of asks up front: 

- Can Redwood run the demo as a short (30–40 minute) core session, then split into regional breakouts for EU/APAC teams to go over latency/cost/regulatory questions?
- We have a small engineering audience that will want a live look at routing and private deployment options; can we get a presenter who can cover Dedicated vs Private?
- Is recording and a shareable deck okay for internal distribution? Any permissions we need to set on Redwood's side?

I attached a short prework doc with the list of attendees and top questions. Proposed week for the QBR: Sept 8–10 (open to other windows).

Best,
Priya Shah
Head of AI Programs
Clearline Health

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-08-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — regional breakouts?

Hi Priya — great to hear from you and thanks for the prework. Confirming we can do the format you suggested. A couple of quick notes and options: 

1) Structure proposal (we can tweak):
   - 30 min: Executive QBR intro + top renewal items (Stephanie)
   - 40 min: Roadmap demo (model routing, Dedicated vs Private tradeoffs) — lead: Marissa (Applied ML)
   - 30 min: Regional breakouts (APAC / EU) — 20 min each, run by Neha and an engineer
   - 10 min: Wrap + action items/DocuSign link

2) Presenter rotation: Marissa can lead the architecture demo; Neha will run the EU breakout and can cover compliance routing. We can bring an engineer for the APAC session if you want deeper latency numbers.

3) Recording / permissions: yes, we can record. We will upload the recording to a private Drive link and can restrict access. If you need us to disable recording until you sign the NDA addendum, flag that and we will pause.

4) Dates: we have availability on Sept 9 (10:00–12:00 PT) and Sept 10 (13:00–15:00 PT). Which window fits your execs?

I attached a first-draft runbook so we can iterate (runbook includes presenter list and ops checklist).

Thanks — I’ll also coordinate internally on owner rotation so presenters have clear handoffs.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-runbook-v1.pdf
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-08-30T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — regional breakouts? (internal ops)

Marissa / Neha — quick internal note to nail down the owner rotation and who takes which breakout. Priya would like the short core demo + two regional breakouts (EU, APAC). Proposed rotation below: 

- Core demo / roadmap (40m): Marissa (lead), Stephanie (exec intro + tie to renewal asks)
- EU breakout (20m): Neha (compliance routing, EU latency numbers)
- APAC breakout (20m): Engineer (TBD) — Marissa, can you suggest an infra/engineer from the serving runtime team?

Ops checklist items for us to confirm before the session:
- Final attendee list and time zone confirmation (Priya to confirm)
- DocuSign link prepared for renewal signature post-demo
- Recording permissions and Drive access (we default to internal-only until told otherwise)
- Runbook: who is the owner of post-demo action items? Suggest making Marissa run the tech follow-ups and Stephanie the commercial/renewal follow-ups.

If that rotation works I’ll send the formal calendar invite to the Clearline stakeholders and include the runbook.

-Steph

Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — regional breakouts & presenter rotation

Thanks — that plan looks good. Sept 9 at 10:00 PT works for our exec + engineering leads. A couple quick points: 

- Please include an APAC-friendly recording (we have team members in SG/IN who will watch asynchronously).
- For the APAC breakout, Amir Khan (cc'd) will join and can ask infra-level questions; if you can include one of your serving runtime engineers that would be ideal.
- We are comfortable with the recording being internal to Clearline and Redwood. No need to hold it.

Confirmed attachments: we added the attendee matrix to the prework; see attached. Looking forward to the runbook and the calendar invite.

Best,
Priya
